  5. The net work done is the sum: Wnet ​= Wg ​+ Ws ​= mg(h + d) . (This expression is what the question asks for, and it is equal to ΔK.E.=0).

    • Dominance (one allele masks another)
    • Unit factors and segregation (each trait controlled by a pair of factors that segregate during gamete formation)
